items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows RB yards weekly. LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches, high util, NYG soft vs RBs.

Price tough start: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet back; still eye-test positive long-term.
